description: Minimal IPFS governance interface for ENS DAO — proposals, voting, wallet connect

userStories.title: Project scaffold — static Next.js shell
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a clean static Next.js project with only governance routing.
acceptanceCriteria: Strip dashboard to governance-only: / (proposals list) and /proposal/[id] (detail)

Remove all non-governance features: token-distribution, attack-profitability, risk-analysis, resilience-stages, holders-and-delegates, feed, dao-overview, alerts, donation, faq, glossary, terms, cookie, panel, contact, donate, aave
next.config.mjs has output: 'export' and images: { unoptimized: true }
Keep: shared/components/ (design system), shared/providers/, shared/dao-config/ens.ts, shared/utils/, shared/types/, shared/services/wallet/, abis/ens-governor.json
next build produces out/ with index.html
userStories.notes: Aggressive strip. Remove entire features/ except features/governance/. Remove app/[daoId]/ routing — flatten to app/page.tsx (list) and app/proposal/[id]/page.tsx (detail). Remove widgets/ sidebar, panel, header components that reference removed features. Keep shared/components/design-system/ as the UI library.

userStories.title: Gateful REST client for proposals and votes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need typed data fetching for ENS proposals and votes from Gateful REST API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shared/data/gateful.ts with typed fetch client
fetchProposals(params?) → GET /ens/proposals with pagination, status filter, ordering
Types in shared/data/types.ts matching Gateful response shapes
React hooks: useProposals(), useProposal(id), useProposalVotes(id) using TanStack Query
Remove Apollo Client, @apollo/client, graphql, @anticapture/graphql-client from deps
userStories.notes: Gateful REST API with CORS enabled. Proposal response has: id, title, description, status, forVotes, againstVotes, abstainVotes, quorum, proposerAccountId, startTimestamp, endTimestamp, calldatas, targets, values, txHash. Votes response has: voterAddress, support (0=against, 1=for, 2=abstain), votingPower, reason, timestamp. Both paginated with items[] and totalCount.

userStories.title: Proposals list page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all ENS governance proposals with status and vote counts.
acceptanceCriteria: / renders list of ENS proposals from Gateful
Each shows: title, status badge, for/against/abstain counts, proposer, timestamps
userStories.notes: Reuse existing ProposalItem component from features/governance/components/ where possible. Status values from Gateful: ACTIVE, EXECUTED, PENDING_EXECUTION, DEFEATED, CANCELLED, QUEUED.

userStories.title: Proposal detail page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to read a full proposal and see vote breakdown.
acceptanceCriteria: /proposal/[id] renders full proposal via client-side fetch
Shows: title, status, description (markdown rendered), proposer, timestamps, quorum
Vote progress bar: for vs against vs abstain with percentages
Quorum indicator showing current total vs required quorum
Votes list with: voter address, direction, voting power, reason, timestamp
Votes list paginated or infinite scroll
userStories.notes: markdown-to-jsx is already a dependency. Reuse existing proposal-overview components. Votes endpoint: GET /ens/proposals/{id}/votes. proposalId in the URL is the full numeric string ID.

userStories.title: Wallet connection and voting power
userStories.description: As a user, I need to connect my wallet to see my voting power.
acceptanceCriteria: wagmi configured for Ethereum mainnet with Alchemy provider
Connected wallet shows address and ENS name if available
Voting power read on-chain via getVotes(address) on ENS Governor (0x323a76393544d5ecca80cd6ef2a560c6a395b7e3)
userStories.notes: ENS Governor ABI already in abis/ens-governor.json. Use wagmi useReadContract for getVotes. Existing wallet config in shared/services/wallet/wallet.ts can be simplified to mainnet-only.

userStories.title: Vote on proposals
userStories.description: As a token holder, I want to cast my vote on active ENS proposals.
acceptanceCriteria: Vote buttons (For / Against / Abstain) on active proposal detail when wallet connected
Calls castVote or castVoteWithReason on ENS Governor via wallet
Transaction simulation before send — error if no voting power or already voted
Loading state during tx + success/error toast
After vote, refetch votes to show updated counts
If already voted, show user's vote and disable buttons
Show 'Connect wallet to vote' when not connected
Hide vote buttons for non-active proposals
userStories.notes: Existing voteOnProposal.ts uses viem writeContract directly — reuse with minor cleanup. Has-voted check: query Gateful votes for connected address OR use governor hasVoted(proposalId, address) on-chain. Governor address hardcoded: 0x323a76393544d5ecca80cd6ef2a560c6a395b7e3.

userStories.title: IPFS build and deployment
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the build to work on IPFS with a deploy script.
acceptanceCriteria: Google Fonts replaced with self-hosted Inter in public/fonts/
Proposal detail uses client-side catch-all route for dynamic IDs
scripts/deploy-ipfs.sh builds and pins out/ with CIDv1
out/ serves correctly via npx serve out
userStories.notes: CIDv1 base32 for ENS content hash. Test with npx serve out -s (single-page mode) to verify routing.
